Name: Jier's HD Portraits for SVE
Author: Aizack777
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/82183963-1668239214.png[/img]
[center][size=3]Download the main file, copy or cut the unzipped folder named [b]Jier's HD SVE Portraits[/b] to your [b]Mods[/b] folder,
[b]but please make sure you have the following mods installed in advance :[/b]

下载主文件，将解压后得到的名为Jier's HD SVE Portraits的文件夹复制或者剪切到你的
Mods文件夹就行了，[b]但是确保你已经提前安装了以下几个mod：[/b]
1.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher atStardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
2.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits atStardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
3.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - StardewModding API at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)
[/url][/size]4.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)

[/url][b][size=3]Also, you can install another mod of ours for a better experience:
[/size]另外，你还可以通过安装我们的另一个mod来获得更好的体验：[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14150]Jier's HD Portraits for SDV at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/82183963-1668242336.png[/img]
﻿Our mod can turn the display of images on or off by simply changing true to false or false to true in the config file.
Here are the steps:[/center][size=3]
[center]我们的mod可以通过简单地修改几个字符来打开或者关闭图像的显示，
步骤如下：
 
1. Open the folder named[b] Jier's HD SVE Portraits[/b] in your [b]Mods[/b] folder and you will see the following four files:

打开位于你的Mods文件夹中的名字为Jier's HD SVE Portraits的文件夹，打开后有以下四个文件：[/center][/size][size=3][quote]﻿assets
[b]config.json[/b]
content.json
manifast.json[/quote][/size]
[size=3][center]2.Then [b]open the file named config.json by using notepad[/b], you can see the following text like this :
[b]
使用记事本打开config.json[/b]，可以看到像是如下的文本：[/center][quote][left]{
 "Claire_HD_portrait": "true",
  "Olivia_HD_portrait": "true",
  "Sophia_HD_portrait": "true",
  "Susan_HD_portrait": "true"
}[/left][/quote]﻿﻿
[/size][center]
[size=3]3. Find the [b]name[/b] of the character you want to change. [b]Change 'true' to 'false' to turn off the image of this character[/b].[b]
[/b]
[b]找到你想修改的人物的名字，将‘true’改成‘false‘就能关闭这个人物的图像显示了，[/b]另外多提一嘴，除了修改true和false外，千万不要修改别的，如果不小心改了并且改不回来了，不保存直接关闭记事本就行。[/size][/center][size=3]
[/size]﻿

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/82183963-1668243368.png[/img]
[center][size=3]﻿[b]It is important to delete the old version of our mod before adding the new version[/b]
There may be other mods that conflict with our mod. If you encounter this situation, please let me know in the comments section.
One more thing,[b] don't forget to remove the same [/b][b]NPC portrait requirements from your [u]Portraiture[/u] or [u]HD Portraits mod[/u][/b] (if you have these)

[b]在安装我们的新mod前，最好把旧版本的mod删除，直接替换可能会出现小bug
[/b]还有可能存在其它的mod与我们的mod有冲突，如果你遇到这种情况，请在评论区告诉我。
还有一件很重要的事，[b]不要忘记删除在 [u]Portraiture[/u] 这个mod里面的，相同人物的图像
[/b][/size][/center]
